description: Summary figure: three independent lines of evidence on HSP-110 ATP binding vs hydrolysis
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
I=pd.read_csv("hsp110_NEF_interface_conservation.csv")
C=pd.read_csv("hsp110_nbd_residue_conservation.csv")
D=pd.read_csv("hsp110_nucleotide_site_distances.csv")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,5.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(1,3,width_ratios=[1.0,1.3,1.0])

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
cats=["Adenosine / ribose\npocket\n(14 positions)","beta/gamma-phosphate,\nMg2+ and K+ site\n(10 positions)"]
adpos=["D10","G12","G201","G230","D234","E268","R272","S275","G339","R342","D366","K71","E175","D199"]
ctpos=["T13","T14","Y15","T37","K56","G202","G203","T204","D206","Y149"]
a=C[C.Hsc70_aa.notna()].set_index(C.Hsc70_aa.astype(str)+C.Hsc70_pos.astype(str))
va=[a.loc[p,"frac_match_Hsc70"]*100 for p in adpos if p in a.index]
vc=[a.loc[p,"frac_match_Hsc70"]*100 for p in ctpos if p in a.index]
ax.boxplot([va,vc],labels=cats,widths=.55,patch_artist=True,
           boxprops=dict(facecolor="#dfe9f3"),medianprops=dict(color="k"))
ax.scatter(np.random.normal(1,.05,len(va)),va,c="#2a7fb8",zorder=3,s=28)
ax.scatter(np.random.normal(2,.05,len(vc)),vc,c="#c0392b",zorder=3,s=28)
ax.set_ylabel("% of 49 nematode Hsp110s\nkeeping the Hsp70 residue"); ax.set_ylim(-5,105)
p=stats.mannwhitneyu(va,vc,alternative='greater').pvalue
ax.set_title("1. Sequence: 49 nematode orthologs\nMann-Whitney p = %.1e"%p,fontsize=9.5,loc='left')
ax.tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)

ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
sub=D[D.Hsc70.isin(["D10","Y15","D199","T204","D206"])].set_index("Hsc70").loc[["D10","Y15","D199","T204","D206"]]
x=np.arange(len(sub))
ax2.bar(x-.26,sub.Hsc70_K_A,.26,color="#1f6f4a",label="Hsc70 (1KAX)")
ax2.bar(x,sub.Sse1_K_A,.26,color="#2a7fb8",label="Sse1 (2QXL)")
ax2.bar(x+.26,sub.Ce_K_A,.26,color="#c0392b",label="Ce HSP-110 (AlphaFold)")
ax2.axhline(3.4,ls='--',c='k',lw=.9); ax2.text(len(sub)-1.6,3.7,"K+ coordination limit",fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xticks(x); ax2.set_xticklabels([f"{i}\n({r.CeHSP110})" for i,r in sub.iterrows()],fontsize=8.5)
ax2.set_ylabel("Closest side-chain atom to K+ (A)")
ax2.legend(fontsize=8); ax2.set_title("2. Structure: the Hsp70 K+ catalytic cofactor site\n1KAX has 6 protein ligands, Sse1 has 1",fontsize=9.5,loc='left')

ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
bg=39.5; obs=100*I.identical.mean()
ax3.bar([0,1],[bg,obs],color=["#aaaaaa","#1f6f4a"],width=.6)
ax3.set_xticks([0,1]); ax3.set_xticklabels(["whole protein\n(background)","Sse1-Hsp70\nNEF interface\n(53 residues)"],fontsize=8.5)
ax3.set_ylabel("% identity, Sse1 vs C. elegans HSP-110"); ax3.set_ylim(0,80)
ax3.text(1,obs+2,"p = 2.5e-4",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax3.set_title("3. The NEF interface is under\nstronger constraint than the protein average",fontsize=9.5,loc='left')
for a_ in (ax,ax2,ax3): a_.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("C. elegans HSP-110 (Q05036): ATP binding and nucleotide-exchange surfaces are conserved, the ATP hydrolysis centre is not",
             fontsize=11,y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("adenosine-pocket retention median %.0f%% ; catalytic-site retention median %.0f%%"%(np.median(va),np.median(vc)))
